title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.00693v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Alt

translated_title: FedMAD：面向遥感图像分类联邦学习的调制感知方向聚合
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）近来在遥感（RS）领域受到越来越多的关注，因为它能够在无需直接访问本地数据的情况下，跨分散的遥感图像档案进行协作式模型训练。然而，当客户端之间的数据分布存在异构性时，联邦学习的性能会显著下降，这种情况通常由地理差异、季节变化以及不同的图像获取和大气条件所引起。为了应对这一挑战，本期快报中，我们提出了一种用于遥感图像分类问题的新型个性化联邦学习框架（称为FedMAD）。所提出的框架将全局共享的表示参数与客户端特定的自适应参数分离开来，在保持全局可迁移表示的同时保留客户端的特定特征。这一目标是通过在骨干网络中集成轻量级调制模块和本地批归一化层来实现的。
tldr: 提出FedMAD个性化联邦学习框架，通过在骨干网络中集成轻量级调制模块和本地批归一化层，将全局共享表示参数与客户端特定自适应参数分离，有效解决了遥感图像分类中因数据分布异构导致的联邦学习性能下降问题。
en_tdlr: FedMAD is a personalized federated learning framework for remote sensing image classification that separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters via lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers, addressing performance degradation caused by heterogeneous data distributions.
